summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a routine Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Sean Summers as an Independent Non-executive Director effective 1 December 2026, following a Nomination Committee-led search as part of board succession planning. Summers is currently EVP, Retail Media and CMO of Mercado Libre and an independent non-executive board member of World Rugby. No stake, price, premium, advisor or regulatory items are disclosed; the filing notes no further matters require disclosure under UK Listing Rule 6.4.8 R. This is an ordinary board appointment, not a forced departure, so no special-situation angle exists.
